title: VIX SAYS MORESELLING... BUT WHY DOESN'T SPY AND QQQ?
speaker: Money Making Market host

macro_themes.view: VIX has confirmed higher on daily and weekly MACD, opening the door to more volatility and selling unless it fails quickly.

macro_themes.theme: Use expected moves to avoid emotional trades
macro_themes.view: Shorting outside the 95% expected-move zone is a low-odds trade; wait for a bounce that rolls over.

calls.reason: VIX confirmed a daily higher low and weekly MACD curl up; 2-hour exploded up with room before center line, so at least one more volatility reaction likely.
calls.quote: the very probable thing here for volatility is to be able to see at least one more reaction

calls.condition: If the SPY 2-hour MACD curls up near the center line, expect a test of the high or a new high; if the 30-minute rolls, test the low and make a new one.
calls.reason: At weekly expected move; SPY can withstand a 2-hour pullback as long as it stays near the center line, no trap signal yet.
calls.quote: if the two-hour chart is able to curl up over here, it should be an attempt to take back these type of areas

calls.condition: If a 2-hour bounce rolls over, swing short; bull case needs a 2-hour pullback that re-confirms positive. 2-hour curl up could reach 736 daily expected move.
calls.reason: QQQ below the 95% expected-move band and in a more negative trend than SPY, but no daily lower high or divergence, so it can withstand a daily pullback.
calls.quote: the highly likely story here is you could get some kind of lower high

calls.condition: If IWM 2-hour rolls down from the 277.93 daily expected move, bearish test of lows; a 2-hour higher low would signal a daily bounce.
calls.reason: Long-suffering IWM near center line with possible daily divergence forming; could still get a daily bounce.
calls.quote: The IWM has suffered for a long period of time. So, we have to be aware that this could still get some kind of daily bounce
